summary: Silicon Motion Technology Corp filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports net sales of $451.0 million, up 32% Q/Q and 127% Y/Y, with GAAP EPS of $3.99 per diluted ADS. The release includes management commentary on business momentum and key financial metrics but does not announce any transaction, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No deal terms or transactional details are present.
